div.span: [Rust: axum, tokio; the only HTTP client is egress.rs]
div.div: Standard APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama) and /x/v1 behind one gate: Host, Origin, key. Management API and live feed for the window. Serving: queue, load, parallel slots, idle release. Model library with update notices, engines with pin and rollback, apps, keys and usage history, OS service integration. It reaches engines through pitwall-loopback and takes every decision from pitwall-core.
